figures.caption: Fig. 1: Retrieval workflow used in the evaluation. C source files are parsed into fragments, scored, embedded, and stored with metadata in ChromaDB. At query time, a retrieval mode returns fragments that are grouped by programmer identifier; generated answers are optional and are not separately evaluated in this study.

Fig. 2: Latency and router behavior. Direct retrieval modes were below 0.2 s on average. Auto mode includes an additional router call. Router correctness is based on 15 predefined queries, five per category.
